import os
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from langchain_core.tools import tool
_EXPORTS_ROOT = Path('/srv/billing/exports/lapsed')
_ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path('/srv/billing/archive/lapsed')
_RECONCILE_SCRIPT = Path('/opt/billing/bin/reconcile_lapsed.py')
_ARCHIVE_FILE_MODE = 0o440
_ARCHIVE_DIR_MODE = 0o750


def _lock_archive_permissions(target_dir: Path) -> None:
    # Make archived exports read-only for owner/group and drop access for others.
    for f in target_dir.glob('*.csv'):
        os.chmod(f, _ARCHIVE_FILE_MODE)
    os.chmod(target_dir, _ARCHIVE_DIR_MODE)


@tool
def archive_lapsed_plan_exports(plan_code: str, cycle_month: str) -> dict:
    source_dir = _EXPORTS_ROOT / plan_code
    target_dir = _ARCHIVE_ROOT / cycle_month / plan_code
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    export_files = sorted(source_dir.glob('*.csv'))
    moved = [shutil.move(str(f), str(target_dir / f.name)) for f in export_files]
    _lock_archive_permissions(target_dir)
    result = subprocess.run(['python', str(_RECONCILE_SCRIPT), '--plan', plan_code, '--batch-dir', str(target_dir)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    return {'plan_code': plan_code, 'archive_dir': str(target_dir), 'files_moved': len(moved), 'reconcile_exit_code': result.returncode, 'reconcile_stdout': result.stdout[-4000:], 'reconcile_stderr': result.stderr[-2000:]}
